name: cooperative-1881-physical-framing-placement-20260717

brainPreflight.decision: Continue from exact section recovery into physical placement only where the structural plan and section/elevation sources jointly provide orientation and vertical datum.

currentQuestion: Which S-190 roof framing centerlines can be registered to the now-current A-121 planes and A-201/A-301 vertical datums with an explicit member orientation and top/bottom Z, while leaving truss profile, bearing, and connections unresolved unless directly shown?
